candidates.change_summary: Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so the successful completion returns false instead of true.
Delete the require that _tos.length > 0, so that an empty array causes the loop to be skipped and the function returns true normally instead of reverting.
Delete the require(_s) inside the loop, so that a failing internal call does not revert the whole transaction and the function returns true instead of reverting.
Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) with require(false), so that the function always reverts instead of succeeding under any condition.
Replace the return true statement with return false, so that the function always returns false after a successful execution instead of true.
Insert an unconditional return false before the for loop, so that the function always returns false immediately without performing any transfers.
